spans.s:
BAṂH, बह् BAH, pp. bāḍha, q. v.;
 🞄cs. baṃhaya, Ā. strengthen, increase. 🞄ava, pp. ávabāḍha, disclosed. ni, pp. 🞄ni-bāṭha, covered up, buried. sam, cs. P. 🞄strengthen, increase.

bandi-graha, m. taking prisoner, 🞄capture;
 -grāha, m. burglar.
bandhan-ika, m. gaoler.

bandh-anīya, fp. to be taken 🞄prisoner;
 to be embanked.

bandha-pāśá, m. fetter;
 -mocanikā, -mocanī, f. (freeing from bonds), N. of 🞄a Yoginī.
bandh-ayitṛ, m. binder.

bandhur-ita, (den.) pp. inclined, 🞄bent;
 curved.
bandhu-la, m. bastard.

bandhū-ka, m. a tree (Pentapetes 🞄phoenicea);
 n. its flower: -puṣpa, n. flower 🞄of the Bandhūka.
